liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (1 review): Listener enjoyed the performance of Dark Star despite missing drums [9]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): Considered the favorite version of Mississippi Half-Step ever recorded [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-12-11.sbd.gems.107885.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 203 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording contains distortion caused by significant ambient hall noise [14]
- **gd1972-12-11.153091.sbd.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: soundboard; 24 songs; 207 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1972-12-11.sbd.cousinit.100398.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 175 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Sound engineers adjusted the mix during Promised Land, making it inaudible; Soundboard is extremely hissy with overly bright equalization settings; China Cat Sunflower has a dropout at three minutes thirty-six seconds [5][7][13]
- **gd1972-12-11.108946.aud.menke.motb.flac16**: audience recording; 24 songs; 206 min; rated 3.38/5 by 8 [6]. Said about its sound: Balcony audience recording features quiet, attentive crowd and clear vocals; Recording contains distortion caused by significant ambient hall noise [9][15]

## Around the show

- Grateful Dead replaced the Allman Brothers for these three shows [5]
- This was the final show of a three-night run [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-12-11.sbd.gems.107885.flac16**: transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Lineage: 7" MR @ 7 1/2 ips.>R@ 3 3/4 ips.>R @ 3 3/4 ips>DVD Tape stock: Black Maxell UDII reel tape. Transfer info: Akai GX 636 >> Apogee Mini Me(24/96) >>… [1]
- **gd1972-12-11.153091.sbd.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: transferred by Matt Smith, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Master 7" Soundboard Reels @ 7 1/2 ips > Reel to Reel @ 3 3/4 ips (Kidd dub for Jerry) > Reel to Reel @ 3 3/4 ips(Will Boswell) [2]. Also: Matt Smith transferred second-generation reels using a rebuilt Revox A77 [2]
- **gd1972-12-11.sbd.cousinit.100398.flac16**: transferred by Cousinit; source: SBD>MR [5]
- **gd1972-12-11.108946.aud.menke.motb.flac16**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe; source: External Stereo Mic >> Sony TC-124 >> MAC [6]
